window-1.title: WindowSwap
window-1.blurb: It drops you into a stranger's window somewhere in the world — ten minutes of someone's laundry line in Tellaro or rain on a Seoul balcony — and it's quiet, weirdly moving, and endlessly re-openable, plus it was built by a couple right there in Singapore.

window-2.title: Charlotte Rohde's new typeface has heart-dotted i's and a plan to overwrite problematic men
window-2.blurb: A typeface designed as a full character — heart-dotted i's, a feminist bit committed all the way to the end, and a launch campaign shot to look like a photocopier running out of toner — which is exactly the kind of type-as-persona nonsense you'd stay up all night making yourself.

window-3.title: Spicy Passion Fruit Mocktail (AKA "Mockarita")
window-3.blurb: Four ingredients, but you get to char a jalapeño over open flame for smoky depth — a tiny bit of theatre for a drink that's tart, tropical, and named like it's in on the joke.

window-4.title: Tour a Family of Four's Maximalist East Harlem Apartment
window-4.blurb: This is a rental absolutely crammed with color and collected junk-with-soul, and it'll give you permission to stop leaving empty walls and just hang the thing.

window-5.title: Cookboys, I12 Katong
window-5.blurb: It's a whole 1970s Hainanese cookboy universe built out in vintage signboards and old shopfronts — basically a persona shoot you can order kopi in, and I need you to photograph the signage before anyone else does.
